title: From Version Conflicts to Decision Conflicts: Selective Revalidation for Long-Running AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.08015v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-running AI agents may read state, reason, wait for tools or human approval, and perform an external action much later. The state that justified the action can change in the meantime. For example, after an agent proposes an 80 GBP refund under a limit of 100, a customer-name change affects only presentation metadata, a new limit of 90 still permits the refund, a limit of 50 invalidates it, and a refund issued by another worker must prevent a duplicate. Standard optimistic concurrency control and version checks can detect that previously read state has changed, but by themselves do not determine whether that change invalidates the pending action's justification. We call any detected version change a version conflict; when that change invalidates the action's justification, it is also a decision conflict. ATR records the explicit, executable conditions that justify a pending action and rechecks only the conditions affected by a change

translated_title: 从版本冲突到决策冲突：面向长时运行AI代理的选择性重新验证
translated_abstract: 长时运行的AI代理可能会读取状态、进行推理、等待工具或人工批准，并在很久之后才执行外部操作。在此期间，支持该操作的依据状态可能已经发生变化。例如，在代理提出80英镑退款（当时限额为100）之后，客户名称的更改仅影响展示元数据；新的限额90仍然允许该退款；限额降为50则会使退款失效；而另一个工作进程已发放的退款必须防止重复。标准的乐观并发控制和版本检查能够检测到之前读取的状态已发生变化，但它们本身无法判断该变化是否会使待处理操作的依据失效。我们将任何检测到的版本变化称为版本冲突；当该变化使操作依据失效时，它同时也是决策冲突。ATR记录支持待处理操作的明确、可执行的条件，并仅重新检查受变化影响的条件。
tldr: 该论文提出ATR方法，通过记录AI代理待处理操作的显式可执行依据条件，并仅选择性重新验证受状态变化影响的条件，从而区分版本冲突与真正使决策失效的决策冲突，保障长时运行AI代理外部操作的正确性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ATR, which records explicit executable justification conditions for pending agent actions and selectively revalidates only those affected by state changes, distinguishing version conflicts from decision conflicts that truly invalidate the actions of long-running AI agents.
